lesson.text: Quick memory: what is one calm tool? (Slow breaths, counting, a walk, talking.) Today: pressure from others, online unkindness and getting help.
You can say no to pressure, even from friends. Never share someone's photo without asking: it can hurt them a lot.
If you get a mean message: it is never your fault. Don't reply, keep it (a screenshot), block, report, and tell an adult you trust.
When stress makes your heart race, slow breaths and noticing five things you can see bring your body and mind back to calm.
Get help for a worry that won't go away or someone hurting you: a parent, a teacher, a counsellor, a doctor, or a free children's helpline.
Try it in the world: open the Calm Corner. Then find BLOCK and REPORT in an app with your grown-up.

exercises.prompt: Friends push you to share a silly photo of someone. You...
exercises.explain: Say no: never share someone's photo without asking.
True: it is brave and wise.

exercises.prompt: A mean message: put it in order.
exercises.explain: Don't reply, keep it, block and report, tell an adult.

choices: to show an adult who can help
to read it again and again
exercises.explain: So a trusted adult can see it and help report it.

exercises.prompt: If someone is unkind to you online, it is your fault.
exercises.explain: False: it is never your fault.

exercises.prompt: Your heart races after a mean message. What helps?
Healthy way to cope, or not?
exercises.explain: Talking and breathing help; secrets and revenge don't.

exercises.prompt: A whole group laughs at a post about someone. You...
choices: stay out of it and support them
exercises.explain: Stay out of it, support them and tell a trusted adult.

exercises.prompt: Who can help with a worry that won't go away?
choices: a parent, a teacher or a counsellor
exercises.hint: People who care and know how.
exercises.explain: A parent, a teacher, a counsellor, a doctor, or a children's helpline.

exercises.prompt: Many countries have a free children's helpline.
exercises.explain: True: Child Helpline International lists them.
